title: OrganizationBasic
description:
Serializer for `Organization` model with minimal attributes to speeed up loading and transfer times.
Also used for nested serializers.

is_active.title: Active
is_active.description: Set this to 'No' to temporarily disable an organization.

is_not_active_reason.title: De-activated reason
is_not_active_reason.description: (optional) reason for why the organization has been de-activated. This will be displayed to users on the web app.

is_pending_deletion.description: Set to True when org deletion has been initiated. Blocks all UI access until the async task completes.
